The Hoard

Original: https://shrouded-lands.fandom.com/wiki/The_Hoard

The Hoard is the great dwarven bank, based in Titan’s Skull but operating across the Shrouded Lands, including in the Shuttered City.

Connections

  • Twenty years ago, the Hoard longbeards introduced an ‘eons-old custom’: gifting each dwarf-child with a coin from the vaults, to reveal if they are numinomancers
  • Hoard dwarves discovered the Misplaced Obelisk (46.01)
  • The Hoard sent dwarves to colonise Olgam or Oskill (09.24) to exploit the metal-rich hills of southern Gore
  • Barca Enmordet (49.03) is one of the Hoard’s colonies beyond the World’s Edge
  • According to rumour, Drogo the Baldfaced has raided the Hoard’s Great Vault.
  • The Hoard is owed money that is currently locked away in the Sealed Embassy of Naros
  • Station Seven (16.01) is operated by the Hoard; the Haunting Dark was summoned to it by the curse of a dying dwarf
  • The Hoard beat their hammers in deep mines to send messages from one vault to another. Anselm Brucoloc can hear them
  • Clan Hagen turned to ransom to avoid their debts being called in by the Hoard.
